answer: Yes, we buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live in a different one, but a few steps apply at a North Carolina store. In North Carolina the registration must be current on the day of the sale, so renew your expired Virginia registration before your appointment and bring the registration from Virginia. A car registered in another state also needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before we can buy it at a North Carolina store. Because plates follow the issuing state, remove your Virginia plates and keep them.
